summary.plain: Five telescopes on a Namibian farm that watch the southern sky for gamma rays: four medium telescopes plus one giant 28-metre telescope, the largest of its kind, run by scientists from more than a dozen countries.
summary.technical: High Energy Stereoscopic System: hybrid array of four 12 m and one 28 m imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescopes at 1800 m altitude in the Khomas Highland, Namibia. First light 2002; the 28 m CT5 telescope's commissioning date was not confirmed by a source fetched this session.

unique_capabilities.value: A hybrid five-telescope stereoscopic array: four 12 m telescopes plus a central 28 m telescope, the largest Cherenkov telescope of its kind, giving both wide-field stereoscopic imaging and a low energy threshold.
